texts: On day 92 of Year 1, the first hard frost came.
The harbor was white with rime in the morning.
The cold wind blew off the sea from dusk until dawn.
Keepers on the Cliff Path added salt-bloom to the mire-essence in winter.
Every lantern on the Cliff Path was salt-bloomed.
The cold wind struck the salt-bloomed lanterns of the Cliff Path at night.
Every lantern on the Cliff Path stayed lit from dusk until dawn.

The harbor was white with rime in the morning.
The cold wind blew off the sea from dusk until dawn.

parse: (: s8_lantern_lit_state_rule (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (On $x cliff_path)) (And (Member (sk_lit $x) lit) (Experiencer (sk_lit $x) $x) (Still (sk_lit $x)) (Start (sk_lit $x) dusk) (End (sk_lit $x) dawn) (Past (sk_lit $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The "Every lantern on the Cliff Path was salt-bloomed" rule conclusion carries no tense atom, dropping the clause's past copula (the distributive-universal pattern puts `(Past (sk_<verb> $x))` inside the conclusion).

The reified event is typed `(Member (sk_salt_bloom $x) salt_bloom)`, the same symbol the substance noun of the previous sentence carries, so via `(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom)` at index 32 every salt-blooming event is derived to be a bloom.

"white with rime" attaches the adjective's PP complement as `Instrument`, but the reified state has no agent and nothing is performed by means of the rime; the adjective-complement rule prescribes the surface-preposition oblique on the state witness, i.e. `(With sk_white_1 rime)`.

"Keepers on the Cliff Path added salt-bloom to the mire-essence" emits the group event only; "add" is a distributive predicate over that bare-plural group, so the per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1) ...)` rule is missing.

q2_gaps: a denominal verb whose base noun is a compound ("salt-bloom" the substance vs "was salt-bloomed" the verb): lemmatization collapses both onto one symbol `salt_bloom`, and the compound-kind rule's mandatory genus atom on the noun then applies to the reified event as well -- nothing separates a noun-kind symbol from a verb-class symbol

the same participle used predicatively ("was salt-bloomed" -> a verb, hence an event) and attributively ("the salt-bloomed lanterns" -> the property `salt_bloomed`): the function test mandates the split but no licensed link relates the two records of one fact

a bare non-deictic season adjunct ("added salt-bloom ... in winter"): seasons are not among the structured `Time` terms (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute) and the deictic-season rule covers only forms like "last spring" / "next summer"
review.notes: The universal rules key on `(On $x cliff_path)` while the lanterns actually introduced carry `(Possession sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path)` (index 41), so those rules can never reach them -- doctrine-conformant surface-preposition handling that leaves the passage disconnected. "stayed lit" is handled correctly as a continuation copular (reified state + `Still` + Start/End + the flat tensed atom), as are the `Ordinal` on "the first hard frost", the natural-force `Patient` subjects, and the -ly-preserving `(Manner sk_burn_1 slowly)`.

issues.reason: The distributive-universal pattern carries the clause's tense inside the conclusion ("All the students passed" -> (Past (sk_pass $x)), and Reciprocals repeats "put any tense/status inside the consequent"), so omitting (Past (sk_salt_bloom $x)) drops the stated past and leaves the Status-predicates unmarked default, i.e. a generic/habitual claim.

The verb class symbol is the very symbol the mass noun of the previous sentence carries with (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom), so the engine's member-of-a-subclass rule derives (Member (sk_salt_bloom $x) bloom) -- an event asserted to be a bloom, which is ill-typed and false whatever the coverage status of the construction.

Complements of nouns and adjectives prescribes the surface-preposition oblique on the reified state witness ((Of sk_full_1 silt) for "full of silt"), and Instrument is reserved for the means an event is performed by -- an agentless whiteness state performs nothing by means of the rime, so the licensed atom is (With sk_white_1 rime).

Coordination & plurals and Quantifiers both require a distributive predicate over a grouped plural ("the dogs barked") to add the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) rule beside the group event, and "add" is distributive rather than collective, so the rule is mandatory and missing.

gaps_confirmed: a denominal verb whose base noun is a compound: lemmatization maps "salt-bloom" (substance) and "was salt-bloomed" (verb) onto one symbol, and the mandatory compound genus on the noun then reaches the reified event -- nothing in the vocabulary separates a noun-kind symbol from a verb-class symbol

the same participle predicative ("was salt-bloomed" -> verb, hence an event) vs attributive ("the salt-bloomed lanterns" -> the property salt_bloomed): the function test in Names and casing mandates the split and no licensed link relates the two records of one fact

a bare non-deictic season adjunct ("in winter"): the structured Time terms stop at Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and the season forms named are only deictic ("last spring", "next summer"), so a bare season has no licensed granularity term
new_gaps: a day-of-year calendar ("on day 92 of Year 1"): the Time term (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot, so a day-numbered-within-the-year reading can only be recorded by overloading it -- no licensed term distinguishes the two

a universal restricted by an entity-attached locative ("every lantern on the Cliff Path" -> premise (On $x cliff_path)) cannot reach a later definite plural of the same things ("the lanterns of the Cliff Path" -> a group witness with (Possession <group> cliff_path)): no licensed form ties a restricted universal's range to a co-referring group, so the rules never fire on the passage's own lanterns
adjudication.defect_summary: The "every lantern ... was salt-bloomed" rule's conclusion must carry (Past (sk_salt_bloom $x)) as a conjunct; the salt_bloom noun/verb symbol collision has NO licensed compliant form (lemmatization fixes the event class and the compound genus on the noun is mandatory, so the false (Member <event> bloom) derivation is unavoidable -- filed as the first confirmed gap); "white with rime" must be the surface-preposition oblique (With sk_white_1 rime) on the state witness instead of Instrument; and the keepers' adding needs the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1) (And (Member (sk_add $x) add) (Agent (sk_add $x) $x) (Theme (sk_add $x) salt_bloom) (Goal (sk_add $x) sk_mire_essence_1) (Time (sk_add $x) winter) (Past (sk_add $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's own notes are right that the (On ...) / (Possession ...) split leaves the universal rules unable to reach the lanterns actually introduced; I have filed that as a gap rather than a defect since both heads are the doctrine-mandated surface forms. The Ordinal, the natural-force Patient subjects, the dusk/dawn Start-End interval, the Cliff Path name-plus-kind handling and the "stayed lit" continuation copular are all correct.
